heading: Location of offices
lead: The Corporation may establish offices in such place or places as it may deem necessary or desirable in the conduct of its business.

notes.heading: Exceptions From Transfer of Functions
notes.text: For exception of functions of corporations of Department of Agriculture from transfer of functions to Secretary of Agriculture by Reorg. Plan No. 2 of 1953, see Exceptions From Transfer of Functions note set out under section 712a of this title.
